system.description:
Use this skill when an ally declares the use of a [Magic Attack] with [Target: Single] who are within 4 Squares from you. Change the [Magic Attack] to [Target: Two]. However, the second target is selected from within 4 Sq from you, ignoring the original range [Magic Attack]. This skill's [Hate] cost is equal to Hate cost of the [Magic Attack].

A special skill that imitates an ally's spellcasting by repeating it and activates magic twice.
